karty.priklad: Ar Ddydd Gŵyl Dewi, mae pobl yn gwisgo'r genhinen ac yn bwyta cawl cennin.
karty.priklad_cs: On St David's Day people wear the leek and eat leek soup (cenhinen → [g]enhinen after 'r, feminine; Dydd → [Dd]ydd after ar).
karty.mnemo: cennin = leeks (collective), -en = one single leek: the emblem of Wales, roasting on a roaring bonfire.

extra.pozn: singular formed with -en from the collective cennin; cawl cennin is from the coursebook (p. 90), the sentence is my own

karty.priklad: Ewch yn syth ymlaen at y groesffordd.
karty.priklad_cs: Go straight on to the crossroads (croesffordd → [g]roesffordd after y, feminine).
karty.mnemo: croes (cross) + ffordd (road): where the roads cross – and a red phone box stands right in the middle.

extra.pozn: plural outside the coursebook (the book does not give it)

karty.priklad: Yn ôl y gyfraith, does dim rhaid i'r arwydd fod yn ddwyieithog.
karty.priklad_cs: By law, the sign doesn't have to be bilingual (cyfraith → [g]yfraith after y, feminine; bod → [f]od after i).
karty.mnemo: A law painted in red on a CAVE wall: CAVE-RIGHT (CYF-RAITH).

extra.pozn: sentence adapted from p. 94; cyfreithiwr = lawyer

karty.priklad: Mae'r ddaear yn troi o gwmpas yr haul.
karty.priklad_cs: The earth goes round the sun (daear → [dd]aear after 'r, feminine).
karty.mnemo: DAI's EARth (DAE-AR): Dai digs the soil of his allotment under a scorching sun.

extra.pozn: own example (only in the Geirfa in this unit); daearyddiaeth = geography; synonym for ground: tir

karty.priklad_cs: That's an interesting fact (diddorol → [dd]iddorol after the feminine ffaith).
karty.mnemo: Sounds like English FAITH, but it's the opposite: a hard FACT, branded into stone with a red-hot poker.

extra.pozn: own example (only in the Geirfa in this unit)

karty.priklad: Prynais i letysen fawr a thomatos.
karty.priklad_cs: I bought a big lettuce and tomatoes (mawr → [f]awr after the feminine letysen; tomatos → [th]omatos after a).
karty.mnemo: English lettuce + -en = one single head, drowning in a dollop of ketchup.

extra.pozn: letys (collective) is from the coursebook (p. 90), the sentence is my own

karty.priklad: Dw i'n cael llawdriniaeth ar fy nhroed yfory.
karty.priklad_cs: I'm having an operation on my foot tomorrow (troed → [nh]roed after fy).
karty.mnemo: llaw (hand) + trin (to treat) + -iaeth: hands-on treatment under the glowing red lamp of the operating theatre.

karty.priklad: Nefoedd wen, mae hi'n bwrw glaw eto!
karty.priklad_cs: Good heavens, it's raining again! (gwyn → [w]en: feminine form and mutation after nefoedd)
karty.mnemo: Heavens! The whole sky fizzes with Bonfire Night sparklers – I've NEVer (NEF-oedd) seen anything like it!

extra.pozn: Nefoedd (wen)! = Heavens!, Good heavens!; own example

karty.priklad: Roedd e'n sioc fawr i bawb.
karty.priklad_cs: It was a big shock for everyone (mawr → [f]awr after the feminine sioc; pawb → [b]awb after i).
karty.mnemo: Sounds just like SHOCK (SIOC): like grabbing a red-hot toaster.

extra.pozn: cael sioc = to get a shock, to be startled; own example

sever.priklad: Roedd o'n sioc fawr i bawb.
sever.priklad_cs: It was a big shock for everyone.

karty.priklad: Pwy sy wedi bwyta'r darten afalau i gyd?
karty.priklad_cs: Who's eaten all the apple tart? (tarten → [d]arten after 'r, feminine)
karty.mnemo: English TART + -en (one): a jam tart, still red-hot from the oven.

extra.pozn: tarten afalau is from the coursebook (p. 95), the sentence is my own

karty.priklad: Pam gwnaeth Anti Mair ollwng yr ysgol?
karty.priklad_cs: Why did Auntie Mair let go of the ladder? (gollwng → [o]llwng after gwnaeth)
karty.mnemo: The same word as ysgol = school: the fire engine's red ladder reaching up to the school roof.

extra.pozn: homonym: ysgol = school and ladder, same gender and plural; sentence from Robin Radio (p. 100)

karty.priklad: Mae bysedd fy nhroed chwith wedi torri.
karty.priklad_cs: The toes on my left foot are broken (troed → [nh]roed after fy).
karty.mnemo: bys (finger) + troed (foot): a toe gone blue with frostbite.

extra.pozn: sentence from the dialogue (p. 96); after fy it is troed that mutates, not bysedd

karty.priklad: Roedd llawer llai o geir ar y pryd, ond dyw hynny ddim yn esgus.
karty.priklad_cs: There were far fewer cars at the time, but that's no excuse (car → [g]eir: plural ceir after o).
karty.mnemo: From English excuse; esgusodwch fi = excuse me. An excuse as cold as hailstones.

extra.pozn: sentence from the letter (p. 99), which has dydy; in a main clause the south uses dyw

sever.priklad: Roedd llawer llai o geir ar y pryd, ond dydy hynny ddim yn esgus.
sever.priklad_cs: There were far fewer cars at the time, but that's no excuse.
sever.pozn: north: dydy instead of dyw (outside the coursebook, table of variants); the letter in the coursebook uses this form, p. 99

karty.priklad: Diolch yn fawr, rhaid i fi fynd ar unwaith. Fi yw'r ficer!
karty.priklad_cs: Thanks very much, I must go at once. I'm the vicar!
karty.mnemo: Vicar → FICER: a vicar in a cassock rides a ski lift, late for a wedding.

sever.priklad: Diolch yn fawr, rhaid i mi fynd ar unwaith. Fi ydy'r ficer!
sever.priklad_cs: Thanks very much, I must go at once. I'm the vicar!
sever.pozn: north: ydy instead of yw (derived from L5), i mi instead of i fi (outside the coursebook, table of variants)

karty.priklad: Rho ragor o grefi ar fy mhlât i!
karty.priklad_cs: Put more gravy on my plate! (rhagor → [r]agor after the command; plât → [mh]lât after fy)
karty.mnemo: GRAVY → GREFI: gravy gone cold and skinned over on the plate.

extra.pozn: own example (only in the Geirfa in this unit)

karty.priklad: Oes hoff le gyda chi i edrych ar yr haul yn machlud?
karty.priklad_cs: Have you got a favourite place to watch the sun set? (lle → [l]e after hoff)
karty.mnemo: At sunset the day closes like a LID (mach-LUD) over a snowman standing alone on the hill.

extra.pozn: machlud is also a verb: mae'r haul yn machlud = the sun is setting; sentence from p. 99

sever.priklad: Oes gynnoch chi hoff le i sbio ar yr haul yn machlud?
sever.priklad_cs: Have you got a favourite place to watch the sun set?
sever.pozn: north: Oes gynnoch chi instead of Oes … gyda chi (L6), sbio instead of edrych (L18)

karty.priklad: Mae gormod o sbeis yn y cyri.
karty.priklad_cs: There's too much spice in the curry.
karty.mnemo: SPICE → SBEIS: a jar of spice left in the freezer, frosted over.

karty.priklad: Ces i deimladau cymysg wrth ddarllen y llythyr.
karty.priklad_cs: I had mixed feelings reading the letter (teimladau → [d]eimladau after ces i; darllen → [dd]arllen after wrth).
karty.mnemo: teimlo (to feel) + -ad: the feeling of an icicle sliding down your back.

extra.pozn: sentence from the letter in Darllen (p. 101)

sever.priklad: Ges i deimladau cymysg wrth ddarllen y llythyr.
sever.priklad_cs: I had mixed feelings reading the letter.
sever.pozn: north: ges i instead of ces i (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Ysgrifennwch yr ymateb yn y grid.
karty.priklad_cs: Write the response in the grid.
karty.mnemo: ym- + ateb (answer): an answer that bounces straight back, like an echo in an ice cave.

extra.pozn: ymateb is also a verb = to respond, to react; sentence from p. 90

sever.priklad: Sgwennwch yr ymateb yn y grid.
sever.priklad_cs: Write the response in the grid.
sever.pozn: north: sgwennu instead of ysgrifennu (outside the coursebook, table of variants)
